prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-resolution UI storyboard image with FOUR distinct LANDSCAPE PHONE SCREENSHOTS arranged in a precise 2-by-2 grid. Overall board about 2400x1350 or similar wide landscape proportions. Each screenshot has approximately 844x390 logical point dimensions and aspect 2.16:1. All four panels equally sized, flat front-on, no phone hardware or perspective, narrow consistent gutters. Modest external captions above each panel: 账号登录, 图形验证码 · 按需, 短信／邮箱验证 · 按需, 完成后返回服务绑定. Small overall subtitle outside the app screens: 验证按实际要求出现，可跳过，也可连续出现. These are alternative login states, NOT a mandatory four-step numbered wizard. Crisp readable SIMPLIFIED CHINESE. This is a UI design review board, not a marketing poster or schematic.
Input image role: attached image is a STYLE AND APP-SHELL REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its charcoal backgrounds, warm ivory primary actions, fine gray dividers, off-white system Chinese sans font, quiet gray metadata, tiny green dots with state labels, restrained native rounded controls. No neon, no purple gradients, no illustrations, no generic security warnings, no decorative card nesting. Reasonable 44pt touch targets. Do not include code or protocol names. The app is Super LOOI.

PANELS 1–3 ARE THE SAME DEDICATED FULLSCREEN VIDEO LOGIN PAGE IN DIFFERENT STATES. They replace the management sidebar while logging in; NO left global navigation rail in these three panels. Identical header about 52pt: left chevron 返回, title 连接米家视频, right 取消. Large clean two-column content below: left around 35% contextual heading, small Xiaomi green icon and a few short useful lines; right around 55% focused form, width comfortable for fingers. Keep the same columns and field/control geometry across states, rather than opening stacked dialogs. Fit every screen within short landscape phone height; no cropped buttons. No mandatory step counter, no invented progress bar, no unnecessary bottom legal agreement. Screen 1–3 do NOT show camera preview or global service switches.

TOP LEFT — ACCOUNT LOGIN:
Left context: small Xiaomi icon, heading 登录米家账号, two-line gray text 使用摄像头所属的米家账号登录 and 用于连接摄像头实时画面. Compact region row 地区 中国大陆 ⌄.
Right form: visible label 米家账号 then dark outlined field with example 138****1234; visible label 密码 then dark outlined field showing •••••••• and eye icon. One warm ivory primary button 登录 below, aligned to form width. Calm spacious composition, no forgot-password/reset flow invented.

TOP RIGHT — GRAPHICAL CAPTCHA:
Same header, left Xiaomi icon and heading 输入图形验证码, short gray text 按图片输入验证码. Right form at same x alignment as previous form: a clearly visible small LIGHT captcha image with distorted gray/blue letters A7K9 and fine noise, alongside quiet 换一张 control. Label 验证码, dark outlined input with a neutral placeholder 输入图片中的字符. Warm ivory button 继续. Preserve signed-in account as one quiet masked context line 138****1234, NOT another full editable password form. Show one restrained inline error below the field in muted red: 验证码不正确，请重新输入, demonstrating retry without another modal. No alarm icon or red banner. Inline error does not erase the captcha picture.

BOTTOM LEFT — SMS / EMAIL CHALLENGE:
Same fullscreen header and geometry. Left heading 验证你的账号. Text 验证码已发送至 and masked destination 138****1234. Small supporting line 也可能验证绑定邮箱 can be in board caption outside screen, NOT a fake channel-switch command in product UI; the product screen shows ONLY the actual SMS destination for this example. Right form label 验证码 above a single wide outlined text input placeholder 输入验证码 (not six separate boxes with assumed fixed length). Under it quiet disabled resend text 重新发送（42 秒）. Warm ivory full form-width button 继续. No new modal or password form; no fake choose-channel buttons.

BOTTOM RIGHT — AFTER AUTHORIZATION, BACK ON EXISTING PROVIDER SETTINGS:
Use reference app shell closely: 72pt left rail with little black two-cream-eyes LOOI icon, destinations 模型/语音/家居/底座/任务/设置, 家居 selected. Header 我的设备 · 6, 服务绑定 selected, 返回 at right.
Below header slim secondary service list around 180pt: 米家直连 selected with two small green dot status lines 控制已连接 and 视频已授权; unselected Home Assistant and bottom subdued 离线演示. Right detail area heading 米家直连 with 更多 ···, region 中国大陆. Two sections separated by fine horizontal dividers: 设备控制 green dot 已连接, secondary 同步设备并控制开关、灯光等, subtle 同步设备 button; below compact row 启用设备控制 with ON switch. Last section 摄像头视频 green dot 已授权, secondary 已关联 3 台摄像头 (illustrative example), subtle 查看摄像头 button. No playing status, no preview frames, no big success interstitial, no success toast necessary. Full screen immediately shows actual resulting authorization status. No duplicate 视频 fourth provider.
Prioritize cohesion, aligned form spines, legible Chinese and realistic phone landscape density. The four screens should make the entire flow understandable visually.
